profile_text.body:
SpaceX, formally SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP, describes itself on its website as a company that designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft. It says it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the stated ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets. The site repeats that description of designing, manufacturing and launching advanced rockets and spacecraft.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in Starbase, Texas, and trades under the ticker SPCX with CIK 0001181412. It also appears under the alias SPACE EXPLORATION TECHN-CL A. No AI products or MCP servers are listed for it, and no individual products are named.

Its litigation exposure is recorded in Texas, with a count of 125, and no specific cases are named.
